A.gazette: Government Gazette No. 15, 16 March 1990: Parliamentary Elections Office, Results of the Grenada General Elections, 1990
A.note: Winner’s votes: the Supervisor of Elections’ declaration in the Government Gazette (16 March 1990). Other candidates, electors on the roll and votes cast: The Grenada Newsletter, 24 March 1990, which matches the Gazette for all 15 winners. The PEO’s later compilation (Old Elections Results) differs in places and is not used for 1990.
